title: Choose the blue Summit Table
question: All four keep the real Plexus logo, multilingual navigation, and the same human-governed journey. Choose the composition that should become both the public site and the simpler Admin system.

options.label: Harbor Agenda
options.lineage: the original Summit Table rebuilt with Plexus midnight, connection blue, and mineral paper
options.thesis: A strong agenda rail and shared bilateral table make the complete journey visible at once.
options.viewport: The left agenda leads directly into the two-party match table, with actions and outcomes integrated into one compact first view.
options.risk: The formal summit language needs careful spacing on smaller screens so it stays welcoming.

options.label: Blue Carbon Ledger
options.lineage: agenda indexes, carbon-copy registries, and precise confirmed-meeting dockets
options.thesis: The public story already behaves like a clean operating workspace, making the transition into Admin especially coherent.
options.viewport: A slim agenda rail, wide process ledger, and intersecting meeting docket create the clearest operator-first explanation.
options.risk: It is the most operational option, so later public sections need enough rhythm to avoid feeling like documentation.

options.label: Night Exchange
options.lineage: dark briefing cloth, overlapping delegate papers, and a live blue workflow tab
options.thesis: Plexus blue takes the stage while physical papers keep the exchange human and accountable.
options.viewport: The agenda and headline sit on midnight while overlapping profile papers carry the workflow toward a signed meeting record.
options.risk: The dark public surface is memorable but would need a deliberately lighter Admin translation.

options.label: Porcelain Route
options.lineage: maritime wayfinding, registry seals, and clean cobalt route diagrams
options.thesis: A bright route system turns the exchange journey into one calm, highly legible path.
options.viewport: A bending five-stage route wraps a central match ledger and a large confirmed-meeting seal on a bright canvas.
options.risk: Its restraint is highly usable, but it has less physical depth than the other Summit Table variations.
